theorem_title: Winning Angel strategies are monotone in power
formal_statement: theorem AngelDevil.angelWins_mono {p q : Nat} (hpq : p ≤ q) (h : AngelDevil.AngelWins p) : AngelDevil.AngelWins q := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
For natural-number powers p ≤ q, if a single power-p Angel strategy survives against every Devil, then a power-q Angel has a winning strategy as well.

The game histories and Devil actions are unchanged when only the permitted jump radius increases.
source: Andras Mathe, The Angel of power 2 wins (2007), Theorem 4.6 and Section 1 game definition; https://doi.org/10.1017/S0963548306008303. Elementary consequence of the Chebyshev jump rule, not a separately numbered theorem.
